name: event_id
description: Unique security/access audit event identifier (insertId deduplication key)

name: recorded_at
description: UTC timestamp when the audit event occurred

name: recorded_at_epoch
description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds (millisecond precision)

name: event_type
description: Audit event category (e.g., conversational_rag_chat, filing_10k_section_read, analyst_feedback_submitted)

name: status
description: Authorization or execution status outcome (allowed, denied_401, denied_403, success, blocked)

name: resource
description: Protected FastAPI route or internal resource accessed

name: tickers
description: SEC 10-K issuer tickers accessed during the request

name: user_email
description: Authenticated user email, runtime SA, or 'unauthenticated'

name: identity_provider
description: Verified identity provider (google_iap, okta_sso, google_workspace_oidc, agent_s2s)

name: roles
description: Resolved RBAC roles for the principal

name: agent_identity
description: Per-agent S2S workload identity when invoked by an ADK sub-agent

name: spiffe_id
description: Cryptographic SPIFFE ID when S2S agent assertion is present

name: iap_assertion_verified
description: Whether an X-Goog-IAP-JWT-Assertion header was cryptographically verified

name: detail
description: Additional structured context (fiscal period, section_id, intent, rating)

name: trace_id
description: OpenTelemetry / Cloud Trace trace ID (32 hex chars) of the API request that produced this row; joins to Cloud Trace and to Cloud Logging entries
